title: Scheme theoretic image of a reduced scheme
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $U$ reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. The scheme-theoretic image of $f$, meaning the smallest closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] of $X$ through which $f$ factors, is the reduced induced closed subscheme on the topological closure $\overline{f(|U|)}$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. In particular, the scheme-theoretic closure of a reduced open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ equals the reduced induced closed subscheme on $\overline{|U|}$.

source.place: Tag 056B (lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced); scheme-theoretic closure is the image of the open immersion (definition-scheme-theoretically-dense).
